name: "Suizokukan Kochira"
source:
You and a girl have come to the aquarium.
Make the most of your limited time here and enjoy the visit.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8891]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
你和一個女孩來到了水族館。
好好把握在這裡的有限時光，盡情遊覽吧。

［譯自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8891]Novelgame[/url]］
